description: This file defines the 'I18NLangString' entity class used in the OrangeHRM system for internationalization. It models language strings with properties such as unit ID, associated group, value, note, version, and its translations. The class includes getters and setters for its properties, adhering to Doctrine ORM mapping annotations.

classes.name: I18NLangString
classes.description: Entity class representing language strings for internationalization, with properties such as unit ID, group, value, note, version, and translations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the language string.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the language string.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the associated I18NGroup object, if any.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the version string, if any.
